plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown, who worked on ideas for new kinds of propulsion, went to Admiral Hyman Rickover, the man who basically started the American nuclear navy. According to Michels, Rickover told Brown to stop wasting his time because the Navy had "already figured this stuff out," which, if true, would mean the military had secretly solved advanced flight decades ago.
